# The level ID
Leave the level id of the level you want to submit.

# Macro 
The macros must be sent by the user,
You can send it via our official eMule server. 

How to do it:

- Open eMule
- Go to Add Server
- Add the MacroDragon server (76.13.0.123:4020)
- Go to 'Shared Files'
- Share it there
